constraints: If menu is a MenuRef, the command applies to all instances of the menu in all processes, and process is ignored if passed.
If menu is a menu number, the command applies only to the menu in the current process's main menu bar unless process names another process.
For a picture file reference, the recommended "path:" syntax (e.g. "path:/RESOURCES/icon.png") should be used; the "file:" syntax is deprecated.
Library picture references (name or number) only work with binary databases; the Picture library is deprecated and unsupported in 4D project databases.

params.name: menu
params.description: Menu number, or a MenuRef menu ID (Text).

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the menu

params.name: iconRef
params.description: Picture file reference (Text, "path:..." recommended, "file:..." deprecated), or a library picture name/number (binary databases only).
